waive.TypeOK: Type shape only; the mutations target the safety promises.

mutations.name: ack-before-save
mutations.why: An enqueue is acknowledged after a failed save.

mutations.name: effect-before-save
mutations.why: The lane runs an effect after a failed save.
mutations.search: /\ ~stopped /\ mem > 0 /\ mem = disk /\ mem \in memOut /\ mem \in diskOut /\ mem \notin effects

mutations.name: remove-tell-before-acceptance
mutations.why: The lane forgets a result before its destination durably accepts it.

mutations.name: reopen-before-worker-exit
mutations.why: A new lane starts while its predecessor's canceled worker is still running.

mutations.name: forget-receipt-before-outbox-save
mutations.why: The destination forgets an accepted result while Tell can still replay.
